name: gasfind
description: European fuel station map with live prices from official open-data sources: free installable PWA, no account, no ads, no paid APIs

paragraphs: GasFind is a free, installable web app (PWA) that shows fuel stations across Europe on a map, with live prices read directly from official public sources.

It is built for drivers who cross borders and want one map instead of one app per country: no account, no ads, no paid APIs, no tracking. It runs in any phone browser and can be installed on the home screen on Android and iOS.

Status: live at and actively maintained. Per-station prices cover 12 countries; every other European country gets its stations from OpenStreetMap and, for EU members plus Belgium, Luxembourg, Serbia and Montenegro, an official country-level reference price. The user interface is currently Romanian-only (an English UI is on the roadmap). Code comments are in Romanian.
features: Map with prices on every station. The marker shows the price of the selected fuel (diesel, petrol 95, E10, 98+, LPG). Colours rank the stations currently in view: green is the cheapest, red the most expensive.
Station card with all prices, the time of the last update, the distance from you and a one-tap Navigate with Google Maps button.
Cheapest nearby: a ranked list of the stations in the visible area.
Country reference prices (EU weekly average or the legal maximum price) shown, clearly labelled, for stations that have no price of their own.
Cross-border comparison: prices in RON and MDL are converted with central-bank rates, so a Romanian and a Hungarian station can be compared on the same map.
